package.description: A tiny native Windows utility for transient processes, file locks, and UI inspection.

en-US.description: A tiny native Windows utility for transient processes, file locks, and UI inspection.
en-US.longDescription: Peek is a portable native Windows utility with three focused tools: Ghost captures short-lived processes and flashing windows, Unlock identifies processes that hold a file open, and Focus inspects the Win32 and UI Automation element under the pointer. Peek runs offline without accounts, telemetry, or an additional runtime.
en-US.name: Peek

zh-CN.description: 用于捕捉闪现进程、查找文件占用和探查 Windows UI 的原生小工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: Peek 是一个便携的 Windows 原生工具，包含三个专注功能：Ghost 捕获短生命周期进程和闪现窗口， Unlock 查找正在占用文件的进程，Focus 探查鼠标下方的 Win32 和 UI Automation 元素。 Peek 可离线运行，不需要账户、遥测或额外运行时。
zh-CN.name: Peek
